svg.text: PG-1 wiring in 3D - 7. PCF8574 board (on the lid): page switch, level lights, board, bay
Open box from above: lid off, face down on the table, the jacks' wall away from you. Seen from inside, so left and right are swapped: the in jack is on your RIGHT.
PCF8574 board: GND -> carrier expansion: gnd
PCF8574 board: SDA -> carrier expansion: sda
PCF8574 board: SCL -> carrier expansion: scl
jumper, its far end glued in the bay
PCF8574 board: GND -> expansion bay: gnd
jumper, its far end glued in the bay
PCF8574 board: SDA -> expansion bay: sda
jumper, its far end glued in the bay
PCF8574 board: SCL -> expansion bay: scl
jumper, its far end glued in the bay
page switch: A1 -> PCF8574 board: P0
page switch: A2 -> PCF8574 board: P1
page switch: A3 -> PCF8574 board: P2
page switch: A4 -> PCF8574 board: P3
page switch: A com -> PCF8574 board: GND
pole A common: solder it on the UNDERSIDE of the PCF board, on the GND pin's solder joint
in level light: leg 1 -> PCF8574 board: P4
in light (swap its 2 legs, or set kSwapLightColours, if the colours are backwards)
in level light: leg 2 -> PCF8574 board: P5
out level light: leg 1 -> PCF8574 board: P6
out level light: leg 2 -> PCF8574 board: P7
4 x 330 ohm: a1 -> PCF8574 board: P4
330 ohm pull-up: solder its leg on the PCF board's underside, on P4's joint
4 x 330 ohm: a2 -> PCF8574 board: P5
4 x 330 ohm: a3 -> PCF8574 board: P6
4 x 330 ohm: a4 -> PCF8574 board: P7
4 x 330 ohm: b1 -> PCF8574 board: VCC
the 4 resistors' other ends joined -> underside of a VCC pin's joint
4 x 330 ohm: b1 -> 4 x 330 ohm: b2
4 x 330 ohm: b2 -> 4 x 330 ohm: b3
4 x 330 ohm: b3 -> 4 x 330 ohm: b4
